Method of Attack: Ransomware attack encrypting MS Windows based files (ADAD SYSVOL and SYSTEM CENTER DPM mainly) and Microsoft Office files (Word, Excel, etc.)
Ransom notes with links to dark web payment site for decryptor purchase
Data theft with stolen data posted on dark web
Discoverer: Argentina's cybercrime agency, Unidad Fiscal Especializada en Ciberdelincuencia
Attack Vector: Ransomware infection affecting Central Data Center and Distributed Servers
Indicators of Compromise: Dark web payment site on Tor
Stolen Data page with screenshots of data from Migraciones Argentina
Ransom demand initially $2 million, increased to $4 million (approx. 355 bitcoins)
